The '''Solaran Language Office''' was the state language authority responsible for standardizing the [[Solaran Language]] and supporting the public use of the [[Solaran Alphabet|Sunline]] alphabet.

== Establishment ==

Source material references the office in connection with the 1898 official Sunline standard. The office likely emerged from the implementation machinery created by the [[Education Reform Act of 1895]] and the [[Solaran Ministry of Education]].

The exact founding statute is not yet confirmed, but the office is source-backed as an institution by the alphabet reform period.

== Responsibilities ==

The office maintained official spelling, public terminology, school guidance, dictionaries, and administrative usage. It helped Solaran remain usable in government, education, business, military communication, law, and public notices.

It also mediated between modern Solaran and older [[Solra]] vocabulary. Prestige terms from the Elder Tongue could be adapted into modern Solaran without forcing the whole population to learn the classical script.

== Role In National Integration ==

Language standardization mattered politically. Solara was a large parliamentary state with regional dialects, a ceremonial language tradition, and a modernizing economy. A central language office helped make printed Solaran consistent across schools, ministries, newspapers, and commercial records.

By the early 1990s, its work formed part of the quiet administrative foundation behind Solara's national unity and public confidence before the [[Solara-Khalindar War]].

== Canon Notes ==

The extracted language page references post-1994 office publications. This draft uses the office's earlier source-backed role in Sunline standardization but does not harden later publication dates as 1994 facts.
